plugins.name: agent-config
plugins.description: The Agent Config Standard (ACS v1) as a reusable skill: layered global/repo/local settings, credential references that keep secrets out of git, and a re-runnable onboarding flow. Other skills and subagents invoke it instead of restating the rules, and vendor its zero-dependency loader instead of copying their own.

plugins.name: text-density-analyzer
plugins.description: Detect repeated information and measure information density in text. Score or fix AI-generated bloat, semantic repetition, and filler content.

plugins.name: fellow
plugins.description: Query Fellow meeting notes, transcripts, AI summaries, and action items via the Fellow REST API. Search past meetings, write recaps into a repo, and bulk-export to markdown. Read-only, no MCP server required.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Run a multi-part task as small, tracked, parallel work packages — one agent, one output file each — with an async question protocol so waiting on human decisions never blocks progress.

plugins.name: code-density-analyzer
plugins.description: Detect AI-generation slop in code — duplication, dead code, redundant comments, verbosity, over-abstraction, error masking, convention violations, hallucinated dependencies, and performance waste. Scores a git diff or standalone files with a weighted composite density score via 10 parallel analysis methods.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Run and manage AI subagents in herdr panes from named presets stored in agent config - start, ask, read, converse, list, stop - and drive the herdr terminal workspace manager: workspaces, worktrees, tabs, panes, and "which one am I in".
